import json
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from part2.capital_flow import runner

def test_same_clock_two_writer_generation_is_coherent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    a_latest = threading.Event()
    release_a = threading.Event()
    b_started = threading.Event()
    b_final = threading.Event()
    original = runner.atomic_write_json
    errors = []

    def tagged_write(path, payload):
        writer = threading.current_thread().name
        original(path, {**payload, "_test_writer_generation": writer})
        name = Path(path).name
        if writer == "writer-A" and name == "latest.json":
            a_latest.set()
            assert release_a.wait(20), "writer A release timed out"
        if writer == "writer-B" and name == "anata_latest.json":
            b_final.set()

    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "atomic_write_json", tagged_write)

    def invoke():
        try:
            if threading.current_thread().name == "writer-B":
                b_started.set()
            runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False,
                            external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=1_800_000_000_000)
        except BaseException as exc:
            errors.append(repr(exc))

    a = threading.Thread(target=invoke, name="writer-A")
    b = threading.Thread(target=invoke, name="writer-B")
    a.start()
    try:
        assert a_latest.wait(20), "A never reached latest.json"
        b.start()
        assert b_started.wait(5), "B never started"
        b_final.wait(10)  # Serialized B may wait until A is released.
    finally:
        release_a.set()
        a.join(20)
        if b.ident is not None:
            b.join(20)
    assert not a.is_alive() and not b.is_alive()
    assert not errors, errors
    assert not (tmp_path / "observations.jsonl").exists()
    names = ("latest.json", "audit_latest.json", "anata_latest.json")
    outputs = [json.loads((tmp_path / n).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
               for n in names]
    assert [x["as_of_ms"] for x in outputs] == [1_800_000_000_000] * 3
    assert [x["_test_writer_generation"] for x in outputs] == ["writer-B"] * 3
integration_decision.acceptance: Both threads exit without errors; archive absent; equal as_of_ms; all three persisted test-only tags are writer-B. A [B,A,A] mismatch fails. Test tags do not enter production schema.
integration_decision.limitations: B completion is observed with a bounded wait; exceptionally slow B can still cause a false pass, so retain event traces and stress repetition in authorized CI. This is a test contract, not an executed reproduction or production repair.
